Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The passing standard is printed in the test-requirements table and agrees with the question count stated on the previous page [A02].
The interpreter paragraph says MVC staff will secure an interpreter and pay the appropriate fees, but the sentence does not make clear who bears the foreign-language interpreter cost, so no payer is stated for that case [A01] (verify NJ-TEST-D-INTERP).
The road test item table points each item to other manual pages; those page cross-references were not copied [A07].
Motorcycle and moped vehicle-rejection items are kept only as a scope-noted continuation block in part C2 [A08].
Election deadlines, interpreter registries, websites and phone numbers are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
